request.objective:
Animate the supplied four-view turnaround sheet as a precise game-character motion study. The entire video remains the exact same fixed 2 by 2 arrangement: upper-left FRONT, upper-right BACK, lower-left LEFT PROFILE looking left, lower-right RIGHT PROFILE looking right. These are four views of ONE identical GameCube-style human visitor, all performing the SAME action at the SAME time. Keep each character centered in its own quadrant throughout. The character has a very large rounded head, tiny torso and legs, muted red soft cap, dark brown hair, cream short-sleeved shirt with red leaf emblem, navy shorts, and small brown shoes. Maintain those exact features and low-poly painted shading. Do not redesign, add details, change clothes, vary the face, add fingers, or replace the body. The reference image is appearance authority, not a collage to be moved around.

Time 0.0 to 0.3 seconds: hold the exact standing pose from the supplied sheet. From 0.3 to 4.3 seconds: all four views perform a looping relaxed walk IN PLACE. There is no movement of the figure's root across the image. Four complete left-right gait cycles in four seconds: each left foot goes forward while the right arm swings forward, then the right foot and left arm. From the front view the feet alternate toward the camera; from the back view they alternate away; from the left profile they walk left; from the right profile they walk right. These directions never change. Give each cycle gentle vertical bob and a tiny cap bounce, no sliding or skating, no large knee lifts, no dancing. The two shoes remain distinct and physically attached. Hands swing near the hips rather than across the face. Preserve the same silhouette scale and sole baseline. Make the middle walk cycles repeatable without changing identity.

Time 4.3 to 5.0: stop and settle back onto both feet in the original neutral standing pose. Time 5.0 to 6.0: a small curious head turn to the character's left, then right, while torso and planted feet stay in their original direction. This is a restrained museum-looking gesture, not a whole-body spin or a camera turn. Time 6.0 to 7.1: lift one hand slightly and perform one small friendly wave beside the shoulder; the same hand in all views. Do not obscure the face, stretch the arm or grow fingers. Time 7.1 to 8.0: smoothly lower the hand and return to the exact supplied standing pose; finish held still.

Locked orthographic camera, constant image size, no zoom, no pan, no tilt, no cuts, no transitions, no text and no extra characters. Each quadrant remains isolated with generous blank margins. The background stays completely flat pure green #00FF00, without cast shadows, floor, gradients, noise, objects or lighting changes. No green belongs to the character. This green matte will be keyed out by the game. Preserve broad soft painted light on character surfaces with no specular flash. Do not animate the reference image itself, grid positions, background or camera. Silent video, no audio. The first and last still anchors are identical and must be honored.
